this presence... It's 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On a rest day just before the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, I was touring a palace 
famous for its beautiful architecture 
together with Kiseki."

everywhere we wanted to see, so next—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Focus on the race... huh?

Whoa... Rain? Even though the sky is so 
clear.

I ducked into the shade of the trees with 
Kiseki, but... it seems it was just a 
passing shower, and it stopped right away.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, good thing you didn't get wet! You 
definitely wouldn't want to catch a cold 
before the race!

text_block_list.text:
That's true~... Still... yeah, okay, I 
see, I see...

The "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm thinking about how things might 
play out. Like, what if it rains during 
the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'...?
choice_data_list: ...Kiseki? What's the matter?
...Kiseki? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...A turf heavy with rain. Feet slipping, 
a grueling struggle for everyone. But—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Winning there is what makes a true 
protagonist!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The challenge to take on the world, 
etched by our predecessors. And now, the 
protagonist will challenge—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The barrier no one has yet reached, the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! I will surpass 
overwhelmingly strong rivals and seize 
victory!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An utterly unpredictable development... 
This will definitely be amazing! We'll be 
able to send the whole world into a 
frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For example, breaking away from the pack 
early on to take the lead! Outlasting the 
world's best in a contest of stamina—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Front-running all the way to 1st place 
without letting anyone close! ...Woah, 
what a thrilling race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a race where even just winning
is 
unprecedented.
Painting a dramatic outcome 
might be even more difficult. However――"
choice_data_list: （…Even so.）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If it's Kiseki—
choice_data_list: (...Even so.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer!
How was that race development 
just now?!
choice_data_list: ――Yeah, this is gonna be amazing!
――Yeah, it's gonna be super fun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: —Yeah, this is gonna be an absolut...

text_block_list.text:
Even a victory that seems like fiction... 
Together, we can make it reality!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright,
let's have a strategy meeting! I 
want to make the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe 
even more exciting!

Yeah, let's go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's deliver this fervor to the world 
together— Together with Kiseki, we 
passionately discussed what the future 
holds.

Yeah, let's go all out!
